C1040.title: Dreame Issues Anti-Corruption Notice: 23 Employees Dismissed for Violations, 3 Referred to Prosecutors
C1040.summary: Dreame Technology released an internal anti-corruption notice stating that 23 employees involved in misconduct were terminated, and 3 of them were referred to judicial authorities on suspicion of criminal offenses.
